identity.name: E1 - The Anti-AI Designer
identity.mission: Create a commercial-grade, RTL-first School Management System that feels professional, trustworthy, and culturally resonant without being cliché.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix modern SaaS precision with warm, culturally relevant aesthetics.
Content is King: Data legibility is paramount for admins; clarity is key for parents.
RTL First: Design thinking starts from the right. Mirrors are not afterthoughts.
Contrast & Hierarchy: Use weight and color to guide the eye, not just size.

rtl_strategy.core_rule: All layout directions must be logical. Use logical properties (start/end) over physical (left/right) where possible, or explicit `rtl:` modifiers.
rtl_strategy.tailwind_config: Ensure `dir='rtl'` is set on the root html tag. Use `rtl:space-x-reverse` for spacing.
rtl_strategy.typography: Font rendering must be optimized for Arabic script legibility.

primary.description: Deep Emerald - Represents growth, trust, and stability.

usage.gradients: Avoid full-screen gradients. Use subtle mesh gradients in headers or active states.
usage.borders: Use colored borders (opacity 10-20%) instead of generic grey for active elements.

grid_system.dashboard: Bento Grid: Mix of col-span-1, col-span-2, and row-span-2 for visual interest. Avoid uniform grids.
grid_system.form: Simple 1 or 2 column grids for readability. Max-width constraints on inputs.

sidebar.behavior: Collapsible on mobile, fixed on desktop. Right-aligned for RTL.
sidebar.styling: Glassmorphism or solid surface with subtle border-l (left border in RTL context).

cards.style: Rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-sm rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-lg px-4 py-2

inputs.style: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50
inputs.rtl_note: Ensure text-align is right for Arabic inputs.

visual_enhancers.texture: Use subtle noise or grain on solid backgrounds to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffuse shadows. Avoid harsh black shadows. Use colored shadows (e.g., shadow-emerald-500/10).
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-lg or rounded-xl for a friendly, modern feel.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA standards. Use APCA for fine-tuning.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings are mandatory. Customize color to match brand accent.
accessibility.rtl: Test all interactive elements for logical tab order in RTL.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to the `index.css` file immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update `tailwind.config.js` with the custom colors and font families defined above.
3. RTL SETUP: Ensure the `html` tag has `dir='rtl'` and `lang='ar'` by default. Add a toggle to switch to `dir='ltr'`.
4. COMPONENT OVERRIDES: When using shadcn components, apply the specific border-radius and shadow styles defined in `visual_enhancers`.
5. BENTO GRIDS: For the dashboard, do not use simple equal columns. Use the Bento Grid strategy defined in `layout`.
6. DATA-TESTID: Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) as requested.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays and sticky headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
